note: Rules with a check or gate that this measurement skips, each with the reason.

rules.file-stays-under-a-size-cap: shipped before the mechanical-checks build; the build order excludes it
rules.rename-leaves-no-stale-name: a diff gate that lists stale lines and never blocks: this scan sees no removals and replay.sh counts only blocks, so its commits record the replay that measured it while it still blocked
rules.block-comment-only: opt-in, and every // it flags is the rule's own mandate, so a false hit can only be a missed tool directive; measured by its directive cases instead of a labeled sample
